description: Pattern (c32, c34; owner direction U13 "끼릭끼릭 탁탁" and its correction: the decision model's place is the ACTION layer, the engine talks): the same request on the same scratch project. engine-path: flags none, the engine reads the request, calls egdesk_run_command, waits, writes. action-first: EGDESK_DECISION_FIRST=on (the default value), code builds the options from the folder (npm test, ...), the Decision model picks one, EG-Desk's own runner runs it, then ONE engine round with the result as context and no tool call: the engine talks. card-only: EGDESK_DECISION_FIRST=card (a PROPOSAL: code-posted result, no engine words, a conversation-layer shortcut): a healthy result ends the turn locally with only the terminal card. action-first-failing: the same on a failing project. Run engine-path and action-first, compare the seconds: node scripts/egdesk-real-engine-timing.mjs compare (see the off/on pair real-engine-action-first-off-v1 / -on-v1).
